_comment: Declarative agent registry. Add an agent = add an entry here (config, not code). 'provider' is any registered harness provider (echo|codex|hermes|grok|claude|pi|devin|command). 'persona' resolves via agents/personas.py. 'dispatch_profile' is the spawnable Hermes worker profile the kanban dispatcher would use; the CEO Studio autonomy runner instead executes 'devin' agents directly via the Devin CLI (model field, e.g. swe-1.6), because Hermes has no Devin model provider. Execution + repair roles run on Devin swe-1.6 so the app can dogfood itself. Critical System Agents (domain-architect/agenda-agent/ba-document-guard) stay on their design-placeholder providers. Projects can override via their own agents.json or $CEO_AGENTS_CONFIG.

agents.description: Reviews code/agent changes before handoff and updates authoritative docs so future agents inherit the current operating model.

agents.name: self-repair-engineer
agents.description: Diagnoses CEO Studio defects and improvement opportunities, implements verified repairs, logs evidence, updates docs when behavior changes, and commits all file changes.

agents.name: dogfood-tester
agents.description: Test agent created during dogfood session

agents.name: Domain Architect
agents.description: Critical System Agent (design placeholder from June 2026 domain lifecycle discussion): Guides structured conversational interviews for new domain creation. Maintains live AGUI outline in left panel. Produces synthesized definition + raw artifacts + explicit handoff to Agenda Agent. Two-layer model (immutable core + editable persona). See domains/domain-lifecycle/docs/design/ and docs/personas/domain-architect.md (inside the Domain Lifecycle domain)

agents.name: Agenda Agent
agents.description: Critical System Agent (design placeholder): Receives handoffs (esp. from Domain Architect), performs triage, creates actionable Agenda Items, routes work, surfaces needs for human attention. See domains/domain-lifecycle/docs/design/ and docs/personas/agenda-agent.md (inside the Domain Lifecycle domain)

agents.name: BA Document Guard
agents.description: Critical System Agent (design placeholder, domain-scoped): Per-domain guardian of documentation quality. Enforces Dirty/Clean states on all documents, detects contradictions, blocks work on dirty docs. Two-layer model. See domains/domain-lifecycle/docs/design/ and docs/personas/ba-document-guard.md (inside the Domain Lifecycle domain)
